title: Adamski's Martian and Venusian Nordic society

tellings.quote: Adamsky says that these beings who come from both Mars and and Venus and inhabit the whole solar system, whatever, he says, "Oh, they're far more enlightened than us.

plain: In the 1950s, a man named George Adamski claimed to meet beings from Mars and Venus who lived throughout the solar system and were, in his words, far more enlightened than us. The philosopher Jason Jorjani sums up Adamski's claims on Michels' show, and the story is tied to a work called Closer Encounters. He tells it as an example of visitors being cast as wise teachers of humanity.
